# CAUSAL PRED


## - Theme

```{r}
scale_factor = 2.5
vivax_theme <- function() {
  theme_bw() +
    
    theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = scale_factor * 13),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = scale_factor * 13),
          
          plot.title = element_markdown(face = "bold",
                                        size = scale_factor * 16,
                                        hjust = 0,
                                        margin = margin(b = 2)),
          
          plot.subtitle = element_markdown(face="italic",
                                           size = scale_factor * 12,
                                           lineheight=0.4,
                                           margin = margin(b = 0.5)),
          # RIGHT TEXT (Caption)
          plot.caption.position = "plot",
          plot.caption = element_markdown(face = "italic",
                                          hjust = 1, # Flush right
                                          vjust = 0, # Anchored to the bottom
                                          size = scale_factor * 8,
                                          lineheight = 0.4,
                                          # t=15 pushes the chart up to make room. 
                                          # b=0 forces it to sit exactly on the bottom plot margin.
                                          margin = margin(t = 3, b = 0, r = 5, unit = "pt")),
          
          # LEFT TEXT (Tag)
          # c(0, 0) explicitly targets the absolute bottom-left corner of the image device.
          plot.tag.position = c(0, 0), 
          plot.tag = element_markdown(face = "italic",
                                      hjust = 0, # Flush left
                                      vjust = 0, # Anchored to the bottom
                                      size = scale_factor * 8,
                                      lineheight = 0.4,
                                      # b=10 exactly matches the bottom plot.margin so it aligns perfectly with the caption baseline!
                                      # l=10 exactly matches the left plot.margin so it aligns vertically with your title/axes.
                                      margin = margin(b = 0, l = 10, unit = "pt")),
          
          # plot.caption.position = "plot",
          # plot.caption = element_markdown(face = "italic",
          #                                 hjust = 0,
          #                                 vjust=1,
          #                                 size = scale_factor * 8,
          #                                 lineheight=0.4,
          #                                 margin = margin(t = 5, unit = "pt")),
          
          # plot.tag.position = "plot",
          # plot.tag = element_markdown(face = "italic",
          #                             hjust = 0, # Aligned to the left edge
          #                             vjust = 1,
          #                             size = scale_factor * 8,
          #                             lineheight = 0.4,
          #                             margin = margin(t = 5, unit = "pt")),
          
          legend.position = c(0.26, 0.8),
          legend.spacing.x = unit(1, "pt"),
          legend.spacing.y = unit(0.2, "pt"),
          legend.direction="horizontal",
          legend.box.just = "left",
          legend.title = element_text(size=scale_factor*11,
                                      lineheight=0.3, hjust = 0.5),
          
          legend.text = element_text(size = scale_factor * 8,
                                     lineheight=0.3),
          
          #  legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent"),
          axis.text = element_markdown(size= scale_factor * 10),
          strip.text.x = element_text(size = scale_factor * 12,
                                      lineheight = 0.3),
          
          legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha('white', 0)),
          
          axis.text.x = element_markdown(size= scale_factor * 10,
                                         hjust=0.5, face = "italic",
                                         margin = margin(t = 0.5, unit = "pt")),
          panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}

```


## - Plot Final Model

```{r}
d0 <- df
d1 <- df

d0$vates <- factor(
  "0",
  levels = levels(df$vates)
)

d1$vates <- factor(
  "1",
  levels = levels(df$vates)
)

d0$vates_by <- ordered(
  "0",
  levels = levels(df$vates_by)
)

d1$vates_by <- ordered(
  "1",
  levels = levels(df$vates_by)
)

pred0 <- predict(fit_final_model, newdata = d0, type = "response")
pred1 <- predict(fit_final_model, newdata = d1, type = "response")

df$innervate_gain <- pred1 - pred0

mean(df$innervate_gain,na.rm=T)

```


```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Duration range where you want to estimate the effect
# ------------------------------------------------------------

duration_grid <- seq(
  quantile(df$duration_s, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
  quantile(df$duration_s, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE),
  length.out = 300
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Create two counterfactual datasets
#
# Start from one valid observation because mage, boss, etc.
# cancel when we calculate prediction(A=1) - prediction(A=0),
# provided they do not interact with Innervate.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

nd0 <- df[rep(1, length(duration_grid)), ]
nd1 <- nd0

nd0$duration_s <- duration_grid
nd1$duration_s <- duration_grid

# Set treatment
nd0$vates <- factor(
  "0",
  levels = levels(df$vates)
)

nd1$vates <- factor(
  "1",
  levels = levels(df$vates)
)

# Ordered factor used in the by-smooth
nd0$vates_by <- ordered(
  "0",
  levels = levels(df$vates_by)
)

nd1$vates_by <- ordered(
  "1",
  levels = levels(df$vates_by)
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Use the GAM linear predictor matrix
# ------------------------------------------------------------

X0 <- predict(fit_final_model, newdata = nd0, type = "lpmatrix")
X1 <- predict(fit_final_model, newdata = nd1, type = "lpmatrix")

# Contrast matrix:
# each row represents prediction(A=1) - prediction(A=0)
Xd <- X1 - X0

# Estimated DPS gain
gain <- as.vector(Xd %*% coef(fit_final_model))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Standard errors for the contrast
# ------------------------------------------------------------

V <- vcov(fit_final_model)

se <- sqrt(rowSums((Xd %*% V) * Xd))

effect_curve <- tibble(
  duration_s = duration_grid,
  gain = gain,
  se = se,
  lower = gain - 1.96 * se,
  upper = gain + 1.96 * se
)
```


```{r}
gain_vec <- na.omit(df$innervate_gain)
ate_mean <- mean(gain_vec)
ate_se   <- sd(gain_vec) / sqrt(length(gain_vec))
ate_lower <- ate_mean - 1.96 * ate_se
ate_upper <- ate_mean + 1.96 * ate_se
ate_label_text <- paste0(
  "Overall Avg Effect\n",
  "+", round(ate_mean, 1), " DPS\n",
  "(95% CI: ", round(ate_lower, 1), ", ", round(ate_upper, 1), ")"
)
```

```{r}
p <- ggplot(effect_curve,
            aes(x = duration_s, y = gain)) +
  
  # Single large diagonal background watermark
  # ggplot2::annotate("text",

  #                   color = "gray75", alpha = 0.25,
  #                   size = 28, fontface = "bold", angle = 30,
  
  # 95% confidence interval
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
              alpha = 0.18, fill="#04007B")  +
  
  # Point 1: Y = 117, X = 120 +/- 10 (Wowhead)
  ggplot2::annotate("errorbarh", xmin = 110, xmax =130, y = 117, color = "#A41919", alpha = 1, height = 2) +
  ggplot2::annotate("point", x = 120, y = 117, color = "#A41919", shape = 2, alpha = 1, size = 2.5) +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "text", x = 67, y = 101, 
    label = "Wowhead\nReference\n(117 DPS)", 
    color = "#A41919", fontface = "bold", size = 7, vjust = 0, lineheight = 0.25
  ) +
  
  # Point 2: Y = 110, X = 180 +/- 30 (Icy Veins)
  ggplot2::annotate("errorbarh", xmin = 150, xmax = 210, y = 110, color = "#0095C3", alpha = 1, height = 2) +

    color = "#0095C3", fontface = "bold", size = 7, vjust = 1, lineheight = 0.25
  ) +

                    vjust = 0, hjust = 1, lineheight = 0.25) +
  
  # 3. Longest 99th Pct: Kael/Vashj (~370s; using 370 as a middle ground for 6:07 and 6:13)
  ggplot2::annotate("segment", x = 495, xend = 495, y = -20, yend = 15,

ggplot2::annotate(
```

```{r}
plot <- magick::image_read("figure1.png")
target_width <- round(2100 * 0.1)

button_img <- magick::image_read("button_magecord.png",paste0(target_width))


button_img_scaled <- magick::image_scale(button_img, paste0(target_width))

# Composite the button centered near the bottom (adjust offset +0+Y for vertical
# depth)
final_img <- magick::image_composite(
  plot, 
  button_img_scaled, 
  operator = "Over", 
  gravity = "South", 
  offset = "+45+15"
)

# Save the resulting composite
magick::image_write(final_img, "./figure1.png")
```

```{r}
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Create two counterfactual datasets
#
# Start from one valid observation because mage, boss, etc.
# cancel when we calculate prediction(A=1) - prediction(A=0),

nd1$duration_s <- duration_grid

  levels = levels(df$vates)

  "0",

  "1",

)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Use the GAM linear predictor matrix

X0 <- predict(fit, newdata = nd0, type = "lpmatrix")
X1 <- predict(fit, newdata = nd1, type = "lpmatrix")

# Contrast matrix:
# each row represents prediction(A=1) - prediction(A=0)
Xd <- X1 - X0

# 4. Standard errors for the contrast

  lower = gain - 1.96 * se,
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Duration range where you want to estimate the effect
# ------------------------------------------------------------

  quantile(df$duration_s, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),

)

  se = se,
  lower = gain - 1.96 * se,
  upper = gain + 1.96 * se
)
```

```{r}
# 3. Use the GAM linear predictor matrix
# ------------------------------------------------------------

X0 <- predict(fit_adjusted , newdata = nd0, type = "lpmatrix")
X1 <- predict(fit_adjusted , newdata = nd1, type = "lpmatrix")

# Contrast matrix:
# each row represents prediction(A=1) - prediction(A=0)
Xd <- X1 - X0

# Estimated DPS gain
gain <- as.vector(Xd %*% coef(fit_adjusted ))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Standard errors for the contrast
# ------------------------------------------------------------

V <- vcov(fit_adjusted )

se <- sqrt(rowSums((Xd %*% V) * Xd))

effect_curve <- tibble(
  duration_s = duration_grid,
  gain = gain,
  se = se,
  lower = gain - 1.96 * se,
  upper = gain + 1.96 * se
)
```

```{r}
  ggplot2::annotate("errorbarh", xmin = 150, xmax = 210, y = 110, color = "#0095C3", alpha = 1, height = 2) +
  ggplot2::annotate("point", x = 180, y = 110, color = "#0095C3", shape = 8, alpha = 1, size = 2.5) +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "text", x = 185, y = 98, 
    label = "Icy Veins\nReference\n(110 DPS)", 
    color = "#0095C3", fontface = "bold", size = 7, vjust = 1, lineheight = 0.25
  ) +
  
  # Estimated causal contrast
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  
  # Reference: no effect
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, color="gray50") +
  
  # # Show where actual fights occurred
  geom_rug(data = df %>% dplyr::filter(vates %in% c("0", "1")),
           aes(x = duration_s),
           inherit.aes = FALSE, sides = "b", alpha = 0.01, color="black")+
  
  # --- ENCOUNTER DURATION MARKERS ---
  
  # 1. Shortest: 99th Pct Karathress (47s)
  ggplot2::annotate("segment", x = 134, xend = 134, y = -20, yend = 15,
                    color = "#5E35B1", linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 134-5, y = 5,
                    label = "Shortest Avg Encounter\nHigh Astromancer Solarian\n(~2m 20s)",
                    color = "#5E35B1",  alpha=0.75, size = 5, fontface = "bold", vjust = 0, hjust = 1, lineheight = 0.25) +
  
  # 2. Average Encounter Duration (200s)
  ggplot2::annotate("segment", x = 262, xend = 262, y = -20, yend = 15,
                    color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 262-5, y = 5,
                    label = "Avg Encounter Duration\nAll SSC/TK Bosses\n(~4m 20s)",
                    color = "grey30",  alpha=0.75, size = 5, fontface = "bold", 
                    vjust = 0, hjust = 1, lineheight = 0.25) +
  
  # 3. Longest 99th Pct: Kael/Vashj (~370s; using 370 as a middle ground for 6:07 and 6:13)
  ggplot2::annotate("segment", x = 495, xend = 495, y = -20, yend = 15,
                    color = "#2E7D32", linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 495-5, y = 5,
                    label = "Longest Avg Encounter\nKael'thas Sunstrider\n(~8m 15s)",
                    color = "#2E7D32",  alpha=0.75, size = 5, fontface = "bold", 
                    vjust = 0, hjust = 1, lineheight = 0.25) +
  
  # ----------------------------------

ggplot2::annotate(
  "label", x = 410, y = 240,
  label = ate_label_text,
  fill = "#F4F4F9", color = "#04007B", 
  fontface = "bold", size = scale_factor*4.5, 
  linewidth = 0.5, lineheight = .4
) + 
  
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0,seq(50,700,100))) + 
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(seq(0,400,50))) + 
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0,650), ylim =c(-20,300)) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Fight duration (seconds)",
    y = "Estimated DPS Gain from Innervate",
    title = "Estimated effect of one (1) Innervate on <b><span style='color:#3FC7EB;'>Arcane Mage</span></b> DPS<img src='https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/large/spell_holy_magicalsentry.jpg' width='11' height='11' style='vertical-align:middle;'/>",
    subtitle = "1,650 Logs containing 9,501 Encounters. Raiding weeks 24-25 of TBC Fresh: Phase 2 SSC & TK<br>Methodology accounts for player, raid, external buffs, and encounter factors. Shaded region: 95% CI.",
    
    tag = paste0(
      "<span style='font-family:forgefooter'>&#xe900;</span> &nbsp; discord.gg/wp55kqmyYG\u00A0&bull; &nbsp;Discfordge &#91;Vivax-Pagle(US)&#93;<br>",
      "<span style='font-family:forgefooter'>&#xe901;</span> https:&#47;&#47;www&#46;github.com/ForgeGit/Mage_Innervate_DPS"
    ),
    
    caption = paste0(
      "Buy me a coffee: https:&#47;&#47;www.ko-fi.com/forge<br>",
      "Version 1 - 14/08/2026 (dd/mm/yyyy) 01:00 UTC"
    ))+
  
  vivax_theme() +
  
  # Position legend in bottom-left inside plot (above Y=0)
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.17, 0.19),           # Relative (x, y) coordinates within plot space
    legend.direction = "vertical",             # Vertical orientation
    legend.margin = margin(t = 4, r = 6, b = 4, l = 6)
  )
```

```{r}
plot <- magick::image_read("figure1_v3.png")
```

## - Residuals

```{r}
df_investigate <- df %>%
  mutate(residual = residuals(fit, type = "deviance"))

# 2. Filter for the extreme negative tail (based on your plot's y-axis)
extreme_negatives <- df_investigate %>%
  filter(residual < -400) %>% 
  arrange(residual) # Sorts so the absolute worst offenders are at the top

# 3. View the relevant columns to see what happened
extreme_negatives %>%
  select(actorID.x, encounterID, amount, duration_s, residual) %>%
  head(20)
```

```{r}
df_events %>%

  wcl_add_relative_time(.) %>%
  group_by(encounterID,encounterName,
           time_since_fight_start) %>%
  summarize(n=n()) %>%
  
  ggplot() + 
  
  geom_line(aes(x=time_since_fight_start, y=n)) +
  facet_wrap(encounterName~.,scale="free") +

```


```{r}
df_fights_kills %>% 
  dplyr::select(logID,fightID,encounterID,encounterName,
                kill,duration,duration_s,
                averageItemLevel) %>%
  left_join(df_events %>%
              filter(type %in% c("cast","removebuff")) %>%
              wcl_add_relative_time(.),
            by=c("logID","fightID",
                 "encounterID","encounterName","duration_s",
                 "kill")) %>%
  group_by(encounterID,encounterName, type,
           time_since_fight_start) %>%
  summarize(n=n()) %>%
  filter(encounterID %in% VALID_ENCOUNTERS) %>%
  
  filter(!is.na(time_since_fight_start)) %>%
  ggplot() + 
  
  geom_line(aes(x=time_since_fight_start, y=n)) +
  facet_wrap(encounterName~type,scales="free") +
  
  theme_bw()
```







```{r}
df_fights_kills %>% 
  dplyr::select(logID,fightID,encounterID,encounterName,
                kill,duration,duration_s,
                averageItemLevel) %>%
  left_join(df_events %>%
              filter(type %in% c("cast")) %>%
              wcl_add_relative_time(.),
            by=c("logID","fightID",
                 "encounterID","encounterName","duration_s",
                 "kill")) %>%
  
  mutate(time_until_end = round(duration_s - time_since_fight_start)) %>%
  
  group_by(encounterID,encounterName,
           time_until_end) %>%
  summarize(n=n()) %>%
  filter(encounterID %in% VALID_ENCOUNTERS) %>%
  
  filter(!is.na(time_until_end)) %>%
  
  
  ggplot() + 
  
  geom_line(aes(x=time_until_end, y=n)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=20) + 
  facet_wrap(encounterName ~ .,scale="free") +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
p <- ggplot(effect_curve,

    y = 140,           # Top edge of ymax
    label = "Icy Veins Estimate",
    color = "#111116",

    size = scale_factor * 3.5,

  ggplot2::annotate(
```
